# DEV Community

> > A community-driven platform for software developers featuring tutorials, technical articles, and career discussions across JavaScript, Python, Go, Java, and emerging technologies.

DEV Community (dev.to) is a social platform where developers share knowledge through articles, tutorials, and discussions. The site covers programming languages, frameworks, security, automation, and career development, fostering an inclusive environment for developers at all skill levels.

## Key Topics

- JavaScript
- Python
- Go
- Java
- TypeScript
- Docker
- GitHub
- GitHub Copilot CLI
- WebGPU
- Security & Cybersecurity
- Test Automation
- OpenTelemetry
- React
- AI Agents
- Open Source

## Getting Started

- [DEV Community](https://dev.to): DEV Community homepage: software development discussions and career resources

## Programming Languages & Frameworks

- [Main concept of react || React](https://dev.to/04anilr/main-concept-of-react-react-342o): React.js fundamentals: component lifecycle, hooks, and class components
- [Install Java on windows 10 in 3 simple steps](https://dev.to/007hyno/install-java-on-windows-10-in-3-simple-steps-5ae8): Step-by-step guide to install JDK-17 on Windows 10 with environment setup
- [I forgot about el.outerHTML so I made this](https://dev.to/0shuvo0/i-forgot-about-elouterhtml-so-i-made-this-19m6): JavaScript htmlToString npm package for DOM element conversion
- [Ocean cleaning game with JavaScript](https://dev.to/0shuvo0/i-used-javascript-to-clean-the-ocean-31ep): Ocean cleaning game tutorial using JavaScript and Three.js

## Automation & DevOps

- [How I Built an Email-to-Google Sheets Automation Using GitHub Copilot CLI](https://dev.to/08562d8/how-i-built-an-email-to-google-sheets-automation-using-github-copilot-cli-481g): EmailToGSheets automation project using GitHub Copilot CLI and IMAP
- [frappe task to learning purpose](https://dev.to/04anilr/frappe-task-to-learning-purpose-1nf3): Frappe workflow automation tutorial for leave management system
- [Mastering Test Automation: Best Practices for Seamless Software Testing](https://dev.to/0x113/mastering-test-automation-best-practices-for-seamless-software-testing-674): Test automation best practices using Selenium, Appium, and CI/CD pipelines
- [Open Telemetry Sampling Techniques in Python/Java/Go: Optimizing Observability with Selective Data Collection](https://dev.to/0x113/open-telemetry-sampling-techniques-in-pythonjavago-optimizing-observability-with-selective-data-collection-56oi): OpenTelemetry sampling techniques for Python, Java, and Go observability
